title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Billing Note: The Monthly Rental Charge
content:
Each billing period, a light rented under **Area and Security Lighting Rental** bills its fixture's monthly rental plus the additional-pole monthly rental for each additional pole set for that light, prorated by days in the first and last periods, with the power cost adjustment billed on the fixture's estimated monthly kWh and sales tax following the service account's schedule. The charge appears on the service account the light is billed on as the area light rental for that billing period.

## How the rental amount is figured

1. The **rental amount** for a billing period is the fixture's monthly rental plus the number of additional poles multiplied by the additional-pole monthly rental, the total rounded to the cent.
2. **Proration.** For every fixture the first month's rental is prorated by the days installed, and the last month's rental is prorated by the days before removal.
3. **Energy.** The rental includes the energy for every fixture, so no separate energy line is billed for the light.
4. **Power cost adjustment.** The power cost adjustment is billed on the fixture's estimated monthly kWh. That estimate is the fixture's input watts multiplied by its annual dusk-to-dawn burning hours, divided by twelve thousand, rounded to the whole kWh.
5. **Sales tax.** The tax rate on the rental is the sales tax percentage of the billing service account's rate schedule.

## Rental and pole rates read by the charge

| Fixture | Monthly rental (USD) | Additional-pole monthly rental (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | 9.85 | 4.75 |
| LED 70W Area Light | 12.40 | 4.75 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | 17.95 | 6.20 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | 22.60 | 6.20 |
| HPS 100W Security Light | 11.25 | 4.75 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | 19.80 | 6.20 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | 13.10 | 4.75 |

## The estimated monthly kWh worked out

| Fixture | Input watts | Annual burning hours | Watts multiplied by hours | Divided by twelve thousand | Rounded to the whole kWh |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | 40 | 4100 | 164,000 | 13.67 | 14 |
| LED 70W Area Light | 70 | 4100 | 287,000 | 23.92 | 24 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | 110 | 4100 | 451,000 | 37.58 | 38 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | 150 | 4100 | 615,000 | 51.25 | 51 |
| HPS 100W Security Light | 120 | 4100 | 492,000 | 41.00 | 41 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | 298 | 4100 | 1,221,800 | 101.82 | 102 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | 205 | 4100 | 840,500 | 70.04 | 70 |

## Worked figures on hypothetical lights (full billing periods)

- An LED 70W Area Light with one additional pole: 12.40 plus one pole at 4.75 is a rental amount of 17.15.
- An LED 150W Flood Light with two additional poles: two poles at 6.20 are 12.40, and 22.60 plus 12.40 is a rental amount of 35.00.
- An HPS 100W Security Light with no additional pole: the rental amount is the monthly rental alone, 11.25.

In each case the power cost adjustment is billed on the fixture's estimated monthly kWh from the table above (24, 51 and 41 kWh respectively), and the sales tax percentage is that of the rate schedule of the service account the light is billed on.
